notes.title: Steam Playtest Application Now Open + Early Access Launching in November!
notes.notes: [p]Hello all,[/p][p]We have lots of exciting news for you today, so let's get to it![/p][h2]New Trailer and Early Access Release News[/h2][p]We've just released a brand new trailer along with a piece of news that we know you've all been waiting for: [b]Long Drive North will launch in Early Access this November![/b][/p][p][url="https://www.ign.com/videos/long-drive-north-official-release-window-trailer"]Head over to IGN to watch the new trailer[/url], and take a look at just some of what you and your friends will get up to on your multiplayer road trip![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/e199f586bea80ca07cac94207c7202a56cad0920.png"][/img][/p][h2]Steam Playtest Applications Now Live[/h2][p]Applications are now open for our Steam Playtest which will run next week, from 1st – 8th September! Head to the Steam store page, scroll to the 'Join the Long Drive North Playtest' widget and hit the green 'Request Access' button now to apply![/p][p]Steam Playtest players are selected at random, so applying does not guarantee participation. Players selected for the playtest will have the ability to invite up to three friends from their Steam friends list, to enable multiplayer testing. The successful applicants (selected at random by Steam) will receive an email from Steam once they have been accepted – so check your email inbox on Monday 1st September (including junk)![/p][p]If you have not received an email by 2nd September and your playtest status on the store page has not changed, you can assume you were unsuccessful this time.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179350/Long_Drive_North_CoOp_RV_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][b]Playtest Dates[/b][/p][p]Applications open: NOW OPEN[/p][p]Applications close/playtest begins: Monday 1st September at 11am BST/3am PDT[/p][p]Playtest closes: Monday 8th September at 11am BST/3am PDT[/p][p][b]How to Submit Feedback[/b][/p][p]Please press F11 to use the in-game feedback function.[/p][p][b]Can I post about the playtest online?[/b][/p][p]Yes. The Steam playtest is not under NDA, so you are welcome to post about the playtest online or stream the game/post videos.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/6f345b386d9e12f1fcfcd318f6e5357814d9e01f.png"][/img][/p][p]That's all for now![/p][p]Thanks,[/p][p]The Long Drive North Team[/p]

notes.title: Playtest Signs Ups are Now Open!
notes.notes:
Development on Long Drive North is progressing nicely as we head towards our Early Access launch later this year, and we can't wait to share more with you when it's ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/11458dd40a450e314a585af2e71b9caf4b50ee6b.jpg[/img]

[h1]We Need Your Help to Playtest Long Drive North![/h1]

[b]Playtest applications are now open, until 5pm BST/9am PDT on 28th April.[/b]

This playtest is limited to a very small number of players and we expect to receive many more applications than we can accept. We are planning multiple opportunities for the community to take part in playtesting before Early Access launch, so make sure to join the Discord to keep up-to-date on the latest news.

This is an exciting opportunity to have your say early on in development and help shape Long Drive North!

Join the [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/RBhJdTWRRJ]Discord[/url][/b] and head to the #announcements channel for sign up instructions!

Thank you,
The Long Drive North team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/2b0954591a68c024b2fc22fde53886138c44b93e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Community Playtests + More Game Info Coming in Spring 2025
notes.notes:
Hello all,

As we approach the end of 2024, we wanted to offer you an update on Long Drive North! The team is hard at work on the game and can't wait to share more with you.

We're happy to announce that we'll be running community playtests starting in Spring 2025. These early playtests will be limited to a small number of players, so make sure to follow, wishlist and join our Discord to be the first to know about them! More information on the game will also be shared in Spring, so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/c7821829ba190a5da31ca8f4ebfeaa6490dd0eec.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, we'll be sharing regular FAQs on the Discord where we round up and answer some of the most commonly asked questions. Additionally, we'll be sharing polls to gauge your thoughts and opinions on the game so far and what you'd like to see from it.

Make sure to join the [b][url=https://discord.gg/RBhJdTWRRJ]Long Drive North Discord[/url][/b], to be the first to hear about new content, playtests, FAQS and polls!

Keep an eye out for more news on the playtests and the game in Spring next year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/efed5ad734da808e52ced14e00c241027ec9afdd.jpg[/img]

Thanks,
The Long Drive North Team

notes.title: Welcome to Long Drive North - Join the Discord Now
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to Long Drive North!

We've been blown away by your support and enthusiasm for our game so far, and cannot wait to show you more in the lead up to our Early Access launch in 2025.

We'll be continuing to keep an eye on Steam forums, and will be sharing much more via Steam announcements like these, so make sure to wishlist and follow the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179350/Long_Drive_North_CoOp_RV_Simulator/

[h2]Join the Discord for Early Playtests![/h2]

You can also join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/RBhJdTWRRJ]Discord[/url][/b] to chat with fellow players, keep up to date with the latest news, and, in due course, gain access to early playtests to help us test the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/ee4070669cc833cf02f13e6ab26402b1e1c5e2f7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Join us on Social Media[/h2]

We're also keen to meet you where you are, so we've set up official social media accounts on [b][url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61568128587459]Facebook[/url], [url=https://x.com/LongDriveNorth]X[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/longdrivenorthgame.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/longdrivenorth/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@longdrivenorth?lang=en]TikTok[/url][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198039/7f39fbd525c00a7b8198fe0718ff371d20669e33.jpg[/img]

We are super excited to have you along for the ride, and to share more about Long Drive North.

See you soon,
The Long Drive North Team
